title: Posthumanism

vibeProfile.oneLine: A critical introduction to posthumanism and the idea of the human.

summary: Pramod K. Nayar's clear critical introduction surveys posthumanism, the body of thought that questions the idea of the human as a separate, superior being and rethinks our entanglement with animals, machines and the wider living world. Covering the field's key thinkers, debates and implications, it serves as an accessible map of a challenging area of contemporary theory. A helpful student's guide to ideas that increasingly shape how we think about identity, technology, ecology and what it means to be human at all.
whyReadIt: A clear guide to posthumanism, the theory that unsettles the human's place among animals, machines and the world.

funFacts.text: Posthumanism draws together thinking from philosophy, science studies, ecology and technology.
